blurb: Cuero makes furniture its founders want in their own homes: comfortable, beautiful and of very high quality.
name: Cuero
short: We make furniture that we want to have in our own homes.
long:
We make furniture that we want to have in our own homes. Everything has to be comfortable, beautiful and very high quality. “It’s comfortable, sturdy, and just plain beautiful. In my opinion it looks even better in person. On top of that the chair is backed by an honest and passionate group of professionals. I cannot recommend this company and their chair enough.”
Justin Michael, USA
